name: One host, two vendors, two undeclared categories
note: First-party tag proxying: the site routes several third-party tags through a single host of its own to survive blockers, so one host legitimately carries two trackers from two vendors in two categories. missing_category dedupes hosts inside each category bucket rather than across them, and vendor_undocumented is keyed per vendor but filed under the host it was seen at — so both emit two findings that share a host. Before `subject` carried the category and the slug, each pair collided on (domain, type, host, '') and the second silently overwrote the first. Both trackers are also server-side here (no cookies), and untracked_cookie deduped on the host alone, so only one of the two was ever reported.
